Pepper Bell Bacterial Spot.organic: Remove infected leaves; spray neem oil or a copper-based organic spray.
Pepper Bell Bacterial Spot.prevention: Use disease-free seeds, rotate crops, avoid working in wet fields.

Potato Early Blight.organic: Remove infected leaves; spray neem oil or compost tea.
Potato Early Blight.chemical: Mancozeb or chlorothalonil as per label.
Potato Early Blight.prevention: Rotate crops, give proper spacing, avoid overhead watering.

Potato Late Blight.organic: Remove and destroy infected plants; spray Bordeaux mixture.
Potato Late Blight.prevention: Plant resistant varieties, ensure good drainage, avoid wet foliage.

Tomato Bacterial Spot.organic: Remove infected leaves; spray copper-based organic spray.
Tomato Bacterial Spot.prevention: Use healthy seeds, rotate crops, avoid overhead watering.

Tomato Early Blight.organic: Remove infected lower leaves; spray neem oil.
Tomato Early Blight.chemical: Mancozeb or chlorothalonil as per label.
Tomato Early Blight.prevention: Rotate crops, mulch the soil, space plants well.

Tomato Late Blight.organic: Remove and destroy infected plants; spray Bordeaux mixture.
Tomato Late Blight.prevention: Avoid wet leaves, improve air flow, use resistant varieties.

Tomato Leaf Mold.organic: Remove infected leaves; improve ventilation; spray neem oil.
Tomato Leaf Mold.prevention: Reduce humidity, avoid overhead watering, prune for air flow.

Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot.organic: Remove spotted leaves; spray neem oil or copper spray.
Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot.chemical: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb as per label.
Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot.prevention: Rotate crops, mulch, water at the base of the plant.

Tomato Spider Mites Two Spotted Spider M.organic: Spray neem oil or soap water on the underside of leaves.
Tomato Spider Mites Two Spotted Spider M.chemical: Use a miticide recommended by your agricultural officer.
Tomato Spider Mites Two Spotted Spider M.prevention: Keep plants well watered, avoid dusty conditions, check leaf undersides often.

Tomato Target Spot.organic: Remove infected leaves; spray neem oil.
Tomato Target Spot.chemical: Chlorothalonil or mancozeb as per label.
Tomato Target Spot.prevention: Space plants, avoid overhead watering, clear crop residue.

Tomato Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.organic: Remove infected plants; control whiteflies with yellow sticky traps and neem oil.
Tomato Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.chemical: Use a whitefly insecticide recommended locally (the virus itself cannot be cured).
Tomato Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.prevention: Use virus-resistant varieties, use insect nets in nurseries, control weeds.

Tomato Tomato Mosaic Virus.organic: Remove and destroy infected plants; wash hands and tools.
Tomato Tomato Mosaic Virus.chemical: No chemical cure; control insects that spread it.
Tomato Tomato Mosaic Virus.prevention: Use certified seeds, disinfect tools, avoid tobacco contact before handling plants.
